advice.emergencyLead: The single European emergency number. It works without your own network and without credit. Mountain rescue (GRZS) is dispatched through 112, not through a separate number.
browse.heading: Mountains & routes
difficulty.brezpotje.desc: Unmarked terrain. Requires navigation, experience and judgement.
difficulty.lahka.desc: Walking, no use of hands. Good boots are enough. This is the word painted on the signpost — learn it.
difficulty.zahtevna.desc: Exposed sections, occasional use of hands, some cable. You need a head for heights.
difficulty.zelo-zahtevna.desc: Continuous cable and real exposure. A helmet and a via ferrata set are mandatory, always — not optional, not weather-dependent.
